readings: Looking only at processing runs whose RAM usage (`memusagegb`) is at least 60.8 GB and whose site code (`zoneref`) matches a site, first work out, for each site code and site access status (`entrystat`), the average RAM usage and the average GPU-to-CPU usage ratio (`procgpu` ÷ `proccpu`, computed as a real-number ratio, not integer division), ignoring missing values. Then, for each access status, give the access status, the average of those per-site average RAM usages, and the average of those per-site average GPU/CPU ratios, unrounded.
queries:
SELECT entrystat,
       AVG(avg_mem) AS avg_memusagegb,
       AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_gpu_cpu_ratio
FROM (
  SELECT s.zoneregistry,
         s.entrystat,
         AVG(p.memusagegb) AS avg_mem,
         AVG(CAST(p.procgpu AS REAL) / p.proccpu) AS avg_ratio
  FROM scanprocessing p
  JOIN sites s ON p.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  WHERE p.memusagegb >= 60.8
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat
) t
GROUP BY entrystat;
